messages:
maria: heads up — seeing missing request traces for gpu-pool requests since ~09:10 UTC, looks like req_id gets truncated at proxy egress
maria: example log lines:
```
2026-03-20T09:09:58Z proxy-2 user=svc-gpu req_id=7f3a9c4b2d...
2026-03-20T09:10:01Z router egress hdr "x-rw-reqid": "7f3a9c"
```
ajay: yup Grafana shows a 5xx spike on proxy-2 at 09:10, correlated with increased tail latency on svc-gpu :thinking:
jamal: noticed a header-rewrite deploy yesterday that touched envoys — might be renaming x-rw-req -> x-rw-trace in some clusters
rachel: deploy-bot: deploy finished: git rev abc123 -> branch/rewrite-headers by jamal @ 2026-03-20T08:58Z
oliver: can we run a Loki query that looks for both header names? try: 
```
{job="proxy"} |~ "(x-rw-reqid|x-rw-trace|x-rw-req)" | line_format "%s"
```
ajay: ran that, found ~200 requests with the new header but many traces still missing; looks like some clients send truncated values (len(req_id) < 8)
maria: also saw Prom alert 'proxy_5xx_rate' firing — it's noisy because the aggregation window is small and the spike was brief
ops-bot: alert: proxy-2_5xx_rate > 0.5% for 2m (firing)
jamal: rolling back the header rewrite now, setting envoy to preserve original header name and not drop/trim values; doing hotfix rollout to proxy-2 first
jamal: patched envoy config on proxy-2, restarting 
deploy-bot: rollback completed on proxy-2 (rev abc123 -> prev def456)
ajay: traces starting to reappear in Loki, full req_id values visible again
maria: confirmed end-to-end traces back, SLO gap closing :thumbsup:
maria: follow-up actions: add ingestion parser that accepts both header variants, record req_id length histogram in Grafana, and relax the proxy_5xx_rate alert to 5m to reduce noise
oliver: i'll open a runbook PR with the Loki queries, Grafana panel screenshots, and steps to rollback envoy header changes
maria: thanks all, leaving this thread open for the runbook PR link
